input.overview: A completed Circuit qualifies Hardbody's center shot, which raises both ramps and exposes Power Rep. Build a Circuit by completing Stations 1 through 4, or by completing any one station three times. Make the qualified center shot, then collect the escalating 50,000, 100,000, 200,000, and 400,000-plus-extra-ball sequence.
input.simpleOverview: Completing Stations 1 through 4, or repeating one station three times, finishes a Circuit. Shoot the qualified center shot to raise the ramps, then hit the exposed Power Rep target for its four escalating awards.
input.summary: Complete all four Stations or one Station three times, shoot the qualified center shot to raise the ramps, then collect the escalating Power Rep awards.

quickInfo.name: Build a Circuit
quickInfo.summary: Complete Stations 1 through 4, or any one Station three times.

quickInfo.name: Raise Ramps
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the center shot after the Circuit is complete.

quickInfo.name: Collect Power Rep
quickInfo.summary: Hit the exposed center target for 50K, 100K, 200K, then 400K and Extra Ball.

quickInfo.name: Use Flex Save
quickInfo.summary: Press the lower flipper buttons to operate the two save lanes.

steps.text: Advance Station 1 with the Blaster loop, then collect its award at the three orange bullseyes.
Complete Stations 1 through 4, or repeat any one Station three times, to finish a Circuit.
Shoot the qualified center shot to raise the ramps and expose Power Rep.
Hit Power Rep repeatedly for 50K, 100K, 200K, then 400K and Extra Ball on default settings.

alternatives.title: Use the playfield doubler
alternatives.when: Use this when Muscle Power is lit and the target return is acceptable.

steps.text: Hit the lit Muscle Power target to double playfield values.
Use the doubled window on Circuit, Station, and Power Rep progress instead of taking low-value filler shots.
Use the lower flipper buttons to operate Flex Save lanes and retain automatic-flip opportunities.
Advance Bonus X through the top inline drops; collect the lit extra-ball award only if event settings allow it.

machineSetup: Confirm extra-ball conversion, Station requirements, Power Rep values, and Flex Save behavior.
Test both Flex Save buttons and lanes, all four Stations, Blaster loop, orange bullseyes, center lift, both ramps, Power Rep, Muscle Power, and inline drops.
